NIGERIA & REPUBLIC OF CONGO

FIELD DEVELOPMENT PLANNING

Case study / Field development planning

FROM SUBSURFACE DATA TO A DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP.

PETROKINETICS ENERGY / NIGERIA

Reservoir characterization, trajectory planning, completion design, production forecasting and cost development supported a marginal field development plan. The scope included NUPRC submissions, alternative development scenarios, sand control strategy and a phased execution approach.

OLIVE ENERGY / REPUBLIC OF CONGO

A cross-border field development and well engineering programme covered reservoir review, resource assessment, trajectory and casing design, completion and sand management, facility concepts and economic modelling. Execution planning accounted for local logistics and regulatory timelines.
